title: Fresh pavement in San Ysidro!
description:
Fresh pavement in San Ysidro! 👏 Our City mill and pave teams just completed resurfacing the northbound lane of Beyer Blvd between Del Sol Blvd and Carnell Avenue. 

After the holiday break, crews will return to finish the southbound lanes. We’re working hard to make roadways safer and smoother across the city! 

#SanDiegoAtWork #SanYsidro
